dedupe_keys.name: perimetre du plan de prevention des risques inondation du bassin de la corne sevrey

description: Périmètre du Plan de Prévention des Risques Inondation du Bassin de la Corne - Sevrey is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This dataset contains the boundaries at the different stages of the development of the PPRN. The characteristic of these perimeters is to be the consequence of an official act and to produce their effects from a specified date. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Dataset Direct Download Service (WFS): Perimeter of the Risk Prevention Plan Horn Basin Flood — Sevrey" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WFS 1.1.0. The listing shows 2019-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
